messages:
emma_partnerships: FYI procurement at AtlasCorp flagged our Marketplace PO — invoice entity != billing entity, and legal wants a short addendum for data residency + SLA liability cap. Need legal + finance input, cc @aj_sales @devon_legal @lucas_finance
aj_sales: ugh. can you paste the PO snippet? is it the remit-to or the bill-to?
emma_partnerships: paste snippet:
```
<PO>
  <BillTo>AtlasCorp, 123 Main</BillTo>
  <InvoiceTo>AtlasCorp Global Inc (US EIN 12-3456789)</InvoiceTo>
</PO>
```
aj_sales: looks like our marketplace listing is under Redwood Labs Inc (EIN 98-7654321) — marketplace won't issue invoice to multiple entities. procurement needs either vendor alias or an amendment to PO.
devon_legal: I can do a 1-page addendum limited to data residency and SLA cap. do we have customer redlines? any fundamental liability changes?
lucas_finance: vendor alias is the cleanest. if they need invoice to AtlasCorp Global, we can register alias but that takes 5 business days and requires W9 + ACH docs. do we have those?
emma_partnerships: atlas says they can supply W9 but not ACH. they prefer to keep payment entity as AtlasCorp Global. timeline is tight — launch planned next Tue.
nina_ops: FYI AWS Marketplace flow allows attaching an addendum PDF to the PO via the seller portal. certified docs accepted: signed addendum + PO amendment. link: https://marketplace.aws/addendum (internal shortcut)
aj_sales: can we do both: start alias request and push signed addendum to portal to unblock legal?
devon_legal: yes. draft addendum now. propose language: (1) invoices remit to AtlasCorp Global for billing purposes, (2) data residency limited to us-east-1, (3) liability cap remains contract value. send to me for quick signoff.
emma_partnerships: can you draft by EOD? I have call with Atlas procurement at 3pm.
devon_legal: will have a draft in 2 hrs. quick Q: does sales accept liability cap at 'total paid in 12 months' or 'total contract value'?
aj_sales: sales prefers 'total paid in 12 months' to keep liability limited. can we compromise on that?
devon_legal: ok compromise to 'amounts paid in the 12 months preceding claim' — i'll put it in.
emma_partnerships: put here the short message I'll use on the 3pm call: "we can upload a signed one-page addendum that will align invoice remit-to while keeping the contract intact; legal estimates 2 hours." thoughts?
lucas_finance: sounds good. ask them to upload W9 to secure alias request simultaneously.
aj_sales: noted — i'll push the script and ask procurement to sign and upload.
marketplace_bot: Attachment received: PO_AtlasCorp_12345_addendum.pdf (uploaded by aj_sales) :package: 
emma_partnerships: awesome, thanks. devon can you quick review the uploaded addendum?
devon_legal: reviewing now, small tweak to para 2. will reupload in 10.
marketplace_bot: Attachment updated: PO_AtlasCorp_12345_addendum_v2.pdf (uploaded by devon_legal)
emma_partnerships: :thumbsup: great. Lucas, any follow up on alias request timing?
lucas_finance: started alias request — ETA 3 business days after W9 receipt. with addendum in portal we'll be able to invoice provisionally but final alias must be in place for recurring billing.
aj_sales: customer happy to proceed with provisional invoice for launch. we need final confirmation by Friday COB.
emma_partnerships: copying this thread into the AtlasCorp procurement thread. will update after the 3pm call.
